entities.summary: Parque del Café is a theme park in the department of Quindío, Colombia, 4 km south-west of the town of Montenegro and 11 km west of the departmental capital city Armenia. The park was founded by the National Federation of Coffee Growers of Colombia and the Departmental Committee of Coffee Growers of Quindío, and opened on 24 February 1995. It consists of two main areas: by the main entrance are the buildings housing the museum and exhibitions detailing the history, culture and process of growing and producing coffee in the region; and in the valley beyond is an amusement park with rides and shows.

historicalSignificance.significanceNarrative: The National Coffee Park has had a significant regional impact by promoting coffee production and culture in Colombia, supporting local farmers and the economy. The park's establishment also contributed to the growth of tourism in Quindío department.
